create_termination_handler_node: create a labgraph node that terminates the graph cleanly upon receiving an ExitSignal
create_termination_handler_state: create a labgraph state class with a signal_received boolean attribute for tracking exit signals
subscribe_exit_stream: subscribe to the INPUT_EXIT_STREAM topic to handle ExitSignal messages from the stream
subscribe_exit_user: subscribe to the INPUT_EXIT_USER topic to handle ExitSignal messages from the user
run_termination_handler_main_loop: run the main loop that polls signal_received and raises NormalTermination when an exit signal is detected
